segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and either your account email or ticket number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi Maya. This is Kevin at Northstar Fabrication. I opened ticket 482917 this morning from kevin.ross@northstarfab.com. We need three more seats added before our training tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m pulling that up in the ticketing system now. Okay, I see your current plan has 42 seats, billed annually, renewal on October 31. You want to move that to 45 seats, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Just three standard users, no admin access. If it prorates, that’s fine, I just need them available today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. I’m in the billing tool now, and the prorated charge for the three seats through October 31 is $186.75. It’ll be added to your card ending in 1142 unless you need a different payment method.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that card is fine. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. Your seat count is now 45. In the admin console, you can go to Users, then Invite Users, and add the three emails. They should be able to accept right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you send me a quick confirmation for the charge and the new seat count?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Already sending it to you and billing@northstarfab.com. It includes ticket 482917, the $186.75 prorated amount, and the updated 45-seat total.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it, I see the email. Thanks, that takes care of it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll mark the ticket resolved, and if anything comes up with the invites, just reply to that email.
